system.description:
Olganyar Inheritance: a craft or ritual. . 1 item slot. Attunement.

Prerequisites: Cooking: Baking[1], Language(Olem) or Cipher

This old, weathered scroll is difficult to decipher. It appears that whoever wrote in it had a shaky hand, and possibly cataracts. They also clearly had no tongue, as the recipes within this scroll are all horrifying. A small note, written on the top of the scroll in a different ink and legible hand, reads “Beware: these recipes are all AWFUL ”.

Cold Resistant Lava Cakes (Rare, Fire): A deceptively reasonable looking small, sweet pastry and a layer of honey glaze hides a seething cauldron of boiling chile paste within. BEWARE: HOT is written beneath this recipe in bold letters. Item Slots: 1 (Small, Quickdraw). Prerequisites to Cook: Prof[3]. 25gp.

Hotcake (Action): When you consume one of these cakes with a body action, take 2D10 damage. You are immune to the effects of cold weather for 24 hours.

Curse Cookies (Very Rare, Salt): These cookies are mostly salt, flour, and vinegar, giving them the gritty texture of wet sand. Rather than baked, they are ‘left in the sun for a day’. Item Slots: 1 (Small, Quickdraw). Prerequisites to Cook: Prof[4]. 100gp.

Consume Banecookie (Ceremony): This item takes a full minute to get down. When you consume one of these curse cookies, remove one Bane Token. You may consume up to one of these cookies per long rest.

Apricot Noodle Soop (Legendary, Fire): This spicy, apricot-laden noodle dish is an affront to all things. The addition of a sulphured egg gives it an additional, horrific pungency. It is truly an acquired taste! Item Slots: 1. Prerequisites to Cook: Prof[5]. 200gp.

Soopfever (Ceremony): Eating this soup takes a minute of concentration. For the next hour, the eater will receive +3 to MD.

Rulebook p.58.
